title: Teen montage:
title_short: Teen montage · Shoes Make Me Feel Fly
headline: One question, four teens: how do new shoes make you feel? Fly, clean, light on my feet, ready for anything.
story: Four teenagers got new shoes at the Mall of America. Each one answers the same question in a few words. Fly. Clean. Light on my feet. Protected from the rain. Then where they will wear them, and a thank-you.
Fast, fun and young. One teen after the other, with a shoe shot between answers. This is the sneaker-culture energy Soles4Souls wants. No need, no hardship, no one teen's whole story.
do: Open on Corey: <q>Shoes make me feel fly.</q> on frame 1.
Cut fast. Put a shoe shot between answers (the four shoe moments are in the rows).
Check the in and out of every shoe shot on scrub.
dont: No name supers in V1. All four are under 18 and one name is not confirmed.
Don't use the “two boxes” story. It belongs to the Second Box cut.
Don't use Jasmine's “nobody can mess up my day”. It is the hook of her own cut.
No need or hardship, no youth-program talk.
No logo, fade or title card at 0:00.
